 Bradford 1-0 Peterborough 
 Rare Peterborough chance as Owura Edwards bursts forward but his shot balloons off target.
 At the other end Bradford's Ibou Touray forces a save from Alex Bass.
 18 5 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'It's brilliant play' published at 20:29 GMT 20:29 GMT 
 Fleetwood 1-0 Arsenal 
 Leon Osman 
Former Everton midfielder on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 Oh, it's brilliant play, it really was. 
 It's just individual strength, desire, hunger, and yes, he got a little bit of good fortune initially, but it's just good play from Fleetwood. 
 They play the ball forward down their left-hand side, Mosquera goes in to try with Ched Evans. 
 The ball bounces in between, and Helm just lifts it with his left foot from midfield to help it over into that space vacated by Mosquera.
 Aaron Loupalo-Bi runs into it, up against Salmon, shoulder-to-shoulder, and when you think Salmon does enough, Loupalo-Bi scuffs it slightly through the legs of the goalkeeper. He will not care.
 141 56 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:28 GMT 20:28 GMT 
 Fleetwood 1-0 Arsenal 
 Arsenal have Fleetwood camped deep in their own half now as they look for a way back but there isn't much space around. 
 Might require a bit of patience for the Gunners.
 145 34 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 DISALLOWED GOAL published at 20:27 GMT 20:27 GMT 
 Bradford 1-0 Peterborough 
 Peterborough are all at sea dealing with a corner as Callum Connolly delivers in a brilliant cross which Macaulay Gillesphey taps into the net at the back post.
 But the whistle goes. It's not 2-0 just yet. There was a foul in the middle while the cross came in.

 Fleetwood 1-0 Arsenal 
 Jake Batty deals with Max Dowman and gives a fist pump to the crowd. 
 Every tackle matters now.

 Bradford 1-0 Peterborough 
 Top, top save from Peterborough's Alex Bass.
 Jake Beesley plays in a fine ball for Bobby Pointon but the Posh goalie is off his line quickly and stays big to save Pointon's effort.

 Post published at 20:23 GMT 20:23 GMT

 Red smoke fills the air at Highbury now with the Cod Army lighting flares and in full voice. 
 Brilliant scenes from these home fans. They lead the champions of England. 
 430 121 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Fleetwood 1-0 Arsenal published at 20:21 GMT 20:21 GMT 
 Aaron Loupalo-Bi (21 mins) 
 Highbury ERUPTS!
 The ball is popping around the middle and it breaks for Aaron Loupalo-Bi . 
 It's poor defending by Marli Salmon to let Loupalo-Bi spin him and slot beyond Illan Meslier. 
 Scenes. 
 2701 709 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Chances at both ends' published at 20:21 GMT 20:21 GMT 
 Fleetwood 0-0 Arsenal 
 Leon Osman 
Former Everton midfielder on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 Chances at both ends there.
 That initial long throw from Fleetwood could have gone anywhere, the flick on was actually to their advantage and went near the far post. With a little bit of luck, it could have fallen to one of their players but great reaction from Arsenal.
 They got down the right-hand side with Dowman heavily involved, Timber getting in a pocket of space, clever little reverse pass, and once it was clipped back, you think they're going to score but it was a brilliant block from Rooney. 
 63 29 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:21 GMT 20:21 GMT 
 Bradford 1-0 Peterborough 
 A fifth Bradford player gets a yellow after Callum Connolley gets in a mix-up on the edge of the box following a corner and has to foul Brandon Khela to prevent a counter.

 Post published at 20:20 GMT 20:20 GMT 
 Fleetwood 0-0 Arsenal 
 Marli Salmon's ball forward is deflected right into the path of Max Dowman and you think he's about to put Arsenal into the lead but he's made a right mess of it. 
 His right foot is obviously a lot weaker than his left. 
 62 72 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 20:19 GMT 20:19 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 Is it mad to be a bit worried for Arsenal here. I understand playing the youngsters but need to balance that alongside the risks of throwing them in on a cold damp night in the North West. Type of conditions that will favour Fleetwood.
 Gregory

 Bradford 1-0 Peterborough 
 Bobby Pointon launches a counter but then sort of loses control a bit and as he slides to win it back catches a Peterborough defender.
 He's shown a yellow too. The fourth Bradford player to be booked.

 Max Dowman lifts it into the box for Viktor Gyokeres but his touch is loose and Fleetwood clear. 
 It's all Arsenal this.

 Old school.
